0022600156.text: The Warriors (3-3, on a three-game winning streak) host the Clippers (1-4, on a four-game losing streak) in Golden State's seventh game of the season, with the Warriors 10th in the West and 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back, and the Clippers 13th in the West and 4th in the Pacific, 2.5 games back. Golden State is missing Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest), while Gui Santos is day-to-day with a knee issue and is a game-time decision; Los Angeles is without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, the Warriors lost 1-3 in the 2025-26 season series, and the most recent meeting was a 115-110 Warriors loss in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
